skillset.skill: 12s CT - 3200% Water DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30.
skillset.arts: For 30s, increase allies' PHY RES by 35% and Allies gain a DMG barrier that negates 15000 DMG.
skillset.truearts: 80000% Dark DMG (PHY). For 45s, ignore 100% of Enemies' DEF and reduce enemies' PHY RES by 70%.
skillset.superarts: 200000% Dark DMG (PHY). When used for the first 3 times in a Quest, doubles own Super Arts DMG Multiplier. Additionally, when Super Arts is used, for 20s, reduce enemies' Dark RES based on how high current HP is (MAX: 200%).

passive.ability1: Increase own ATK based on how high current HP is (MAX: 200%). Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: Increase own DMG by [1% × own ATK/100].
passive.ability3: Increase DMG against Enemies in BREAK by 50%.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Demon Rem's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Demon Rem's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: Rem's Spiked Iron Ball
trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 5000% Dark DMG (PHY). For 10s, reduce enemies' Dark RES by 40%. Additionally if user is Demon, for 10s, increase own ATK by 40%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Demon Rem, increase own Arts by 3/s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
